headline: Friday in Branson: Mostly Cloudy with Live Comedy & Family Shows
lede: Friday, October 30 brings highs near 77°F under mostly cloudy skies with light southeast winds — ideal for first-timers to enjoy indoor theaters, the Branson Landing, and Halloween-themed family events without summer crowds or heat.

featured.title: Branson Comedy Bash
featured.where: Shepherd of the Hills / Playhouse Theatre
featured.why: New 2026 comedy show featuring top regional talent. Perfect evening entertainment for the whole family as Halloween weekend begins.

plan.title: Branson Landing Stroll
plan.detail: Start with waterfront views, shops, and the iconic fountain show. Mild fall weather makes it comfortable for walking and photos.

plan.title: Theater Matinees
plan.detail: Catch family-friendly shows like Hot Rods & High Heels, The Lion The Witch and the Wardrobe, or Shanghai Circus. Many start around 2 PM.

plan.title: Comedy & Halloween Fun
plan.detail: Head to the Branson Comedy Bash or free BOOnanza at RecPlex (6-8 PM). Safe trick-or-treating vibes begin the Halloween weekend.

indoor.name: Shepherd of the Hills
indoor.detail: Home to the new Branson Comedy Bash and classic outdoor drama. Climate-controlled theaters with multiple shows daily.

indoor.name: Americana Theatre
indoor.detail: Country, gospel, and magic shows in a comfortable setting. Rick Thomas magic and Absolutely Country, Definitely Gospel on Friday.

indoor.name: Clay Cooper Theatre
indoor.detail: High-energy country music and comedy. A Branson staple with multiple performances suitable for all ages.
